m01:room.title: The Intake Chemistry House
m01:room.job: Say whether the water at the pumps goes over the closure setpoint at high tide.

m02:room.title: The Watershed Routing Shed
m02:room.job: Find the mass of nitrate the first flush would carry into the nursery marsh.

m03:room.title: The Oxygen Process Hall
m03:room.job: Say how far the oxygen in the refuge channel falls before dawn.

m04:room.title: The Marsh Hydraulics Pavilion
m04:room.job: Say which repair keeps the waves below the levee's freeboard.

m05:room.title: The Contaminant Analysis Lab
m05:room.job: Say what the benzene in Heron Creek would come to in the main channel.

m06:room.title: The Food Web Field House
m06:room.job: Say which crab beds are safe for children to eat from.

m07:room.title: The Population Dynamics Station
m07:room.job: Say whether this week's catch on Grand Reef is more than the reef can replace.

m08:room.title: The Barrier Ecology Observatory
m08:room.job: Say which habitat link brings the most species back.

m09:room.title: The Soil Recovery Barn
m09:room.job: Say which replanting plan keeps soil loss under the tolerance.

m10:room.title: The Pump Energy Control Room
m10:room.job: Say which power plan keeps Canal Row under the fine-particle standard.

m11:room.title: The Aquifer Operations Vault
m11:room.job: Say whether the river and the wells can supply a city twice this size.

m12:room.title: The Climate Projection Room
m12:room.job: Say whether the old pump floor stands high enough for the next thirty years.

m13:room.title: The Field Methods Annex
m13:room.job: Say whether the treatment marsh itself earned the contractor's bonus.

m14:room.title: The Estuary Decision Forum
m14:room.job: Say which drainage route meets the permit's exposure cap.

m15:room.title: The Northgate Command Center
m15:room.job: Say at what rate Northgate can reopen, and under which controls.
